'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Jan Westergard DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''We Can't Repel Flavor of that Magnitude!'''. The sheet lists 60 main-deck lines and 12 shields.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

== Transcription notes ==

* Name box reads "JAN WESTERGARD"; the username box reads "Ghostt…" (partly faint), matching his username Ghosttrain on other Players Committee sheets.
* Lines 13–15 use joke names; the real card is written in brackets on each line (on line 13 "Capacitors" is struck and "Coolant Shaft" written above).
* Line 9 is written "Capn Ednor Sehild" with the (V) box checked; the card could not be identified.
* Line 32 is written "Darth Vader's" with the (V) box checked; the rest of the title is not on the sheet.
* Line 48 is written "The Emperor's Reach"; no card by that name was found.
* Lines 53–54 are written "Naboo" and "Tatooine" with a bracket "(EP1)".
* Lines in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card or its version could not be identified for certain.
